collector.legal_raw_outcomes: A never-released root can consume exec-gate EOF and exit125, or remain unscheduled until the existing KILL escalation reaches min(250ms, grace/2). The new test accepts only these two preserved raw outcomes.
collector.limits: The event ordering is an internal causal consistency proof under the original owned-process test model. It does not establish protection against an external ptracer/signaller, new performance qualification, or actual execution of either branch in this static review.
new_causal_requirements: Exact launch-error cause and injected error text
One actual child and final wait4 ECHILD, same birth identity and collector parent
No truncated records, no root-exec-released event, and no TERM event for this root
wait4 status translates to root returncode and agrees with waitid code/status
For SIGKILL, require same-root sent event from this collector between cleanup-start and actual reap
Wrapper exit125, no marker execution, command_success=false and collector_wait_domain_reaped=false remain required
collector.original_mock_controls: The two unchanged deterministic controls still require the precise original KILL boundary, TERM deferral only for a confirmed closed/unreleased root, no deadline extension, and normal TERM for released/unconfirmed cases.

public_v2.failure_priority: Malformed-context/signature errors remain before the new deadline rejection. The production check only converts a would-be valid late response into an error.

new_tests.meaning: One actual signed loopback Head on-time result, then a thread-local test-only delay after successful verification until the same 2s caller deadline; require exact deadline error, the verification hook reached, and two server reads. A second case supplies an already elapsed caller deadline and requires no accepted TCP connection.
new_tests.not_measured: Tests were not run in this review; the 2s test is not a hosted 4s performance observation.

public_v2.production_change: After canonical response context and signature checks, reject when Instant::now() is not less than the same total_deadline constructed at client entry. No phase or nonce budget is rebased.
public_v2.test_injection: Both state cells and the helper are cfg(test); thread-local state is consumed with replace(false) and reset by the test, with no cross-thread armed flag.
unchanged: All signed context/profile/network/genesis/body identities and verification
Server reactor and Host verification calls
Existing phase limits and per-caller outer deadline minimum

remaining: Any use of this new source as a final candidate requires its own exact-source original gates. The response-boundary correction is stricter acceptance, and the collector change is a test correction for existing cleanup behavior; neither is evidence that the separate W1/PQ deadline failures have been resolved.
source_basis: strict reconstruction of pinned complete API patch and immutable R1 blob; no new network/blob request
